cost_specificity: All conclusions are specific to the fixed scalar homodyne MSE cost and recorded initialization ensemble.
finite_size_interpretation: This diagnostic probes the accessible N<=5 and L<=3 regime. It does not establish or exclude asymptotic barren plateaus.

initialization.legacy_uniform: Independent U[0,1) parameters, matching the historical initialization distribution rather than a specific old vector.

literature_context.reference: B. Zhang and Q. Zhuang, Energy-dependent barren plateau in bosonic variational quantum circuits, arXiv:2305.01799; Quantum Sci. Technol. 10, 015009 (2025).
literature_context.scope_caveat: That theorem concerns different bosonic variational ansatze and costs. The present Gaussian-plus-ladder, conditionally normalized QONN scan is exploratory and is not claimed to be covered by the theorem.

paired_design: K and energy scale are excluded from the parameter seed, so comparisons at fixed N,L use paired underlying random draws.
primary_metric: median across parameters of sample Var_theta[dC/dtheta_i]
